record.title: Bitcoin U.S. Spot ETF Net-Flow Next-Day Drift
record.intake_caveat: Core source-backed finding is useful, but causal interpretation is not clean: ETF flows and BTC returns exhibit feedback, flow persistence can generate apparent multi-day drift, and exact point-in-time publication timestamp, execution cutoff, threshold, sizing, and costed standalone trading rule remain underspecified.
contradictions: The primary working paper reports both flow-to-return predictability and return-to-flow feedback, so causal interpretation is not clean.

The same paper reports that individual flow shocks reverse after conditioning on future flows, implying that observed multi-day drift may reflect persistent follow-on flows rather than permanent information.
